quest.title: At Tunnel's End, Light
quest.description: You and the others make a valiant joint effort and finally manage to escape from the underground at the very last minute...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x875, Primogem x60, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Well, well... This is not what I was expecting...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, seems like you've made a new discovery?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This information was left by a thaumaturge called Boyang... who, as you know, is the missing ancestor that I came here to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All this information... it was left by your ancestor?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hundreds of years ago, two of my ancestors, brothers, were gifted the Fantastic Compass by someone of great importance. They brought this device to The Chasm and joined the war against the monsters of Khaenri'ah.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: They set out together, but only one of them made it back... minus his sanity.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Karma.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Correct. One possibility is that when they fought alongside Bosacius, they were tainted by his karma. Neither of them had Visions, so they wouldn't have been able to resist its effects for very long.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: From reading through this, it sounds like Boyang... ended up staying here for good, too.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Ugh, well this is just wonderful! So that's it, there's no way out?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do we do? Are we going to die here? But Paimon doesn't wanna die!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I just had a thought. Gimme a second, I just need to double-check...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Aha. Mm-hmm.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, I just realized something. Okay, so on my way here, I was studying the will the whole time, but I didn't give any thought to the book that the will was inside of.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I don't know it verbatim, but I have read it before. The gist of the story goes like this:

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Millennia ago, an adeptus made a magic device to seal away evil monsters. Later, he made good friends with a human, and gave the device to him to use as a catalyst.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: A few years later, great demons haunted the mountains. The mortal and the adeptus joined forces to exorcise them using this same device.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And that's not all. The book also says this: "When mortal and adepti powers are combined, one can move the heavens and shake the earth. This contraption is proof that mortals and adepti may coexist, that there is unity between heaven and humanity."

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I have both adepti and human lineage. Maybe my power can work...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It worked! I mean, the effect only lasted an instant, because I'm not strong enough... but still, we must be on the right track.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And look! Something seems to have been activated inside the Fantastic Compass...

dialogues.speaker: Sound From Within the Compass
dialogues.text: By heaven's might and the gods of the five regions, yaksha and mortal together take this contraption in hand...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan's Ancestor
dialogues.text: By heaven's might and the gods of the five regions, yaksha and mortal together take this contraption in hand...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: That's their voices from when they made the seal. Bosacius and my ancestor... they sealed off this space at the top together.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...I see. It makes sense now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hold on, that huge crystal I saw in the bottom of The Chasm...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I remember when the crystal hit the Ruin Serpent... there seemed to be an opposing force.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Was it that opposing force that delayed the awakening of the space that has now swallowed us? Or did the impact weaken the entrance on the ground?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Also... We haven't seen any Abyss monsters in here. Could this all be connected?)

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Everyone! Let's go back and meet up with Itto and Shinobu. I have a suggestion to make.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon can barely move anymore... Wah, why can't we get out of here, Paimon doesn't wanna die, Paimon wants to stay with you, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Paimon, just hang in there, okay? Trust me. There's still hope.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Let's go.

talks.objective: Go back and meet up with the ones left behind

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Shinobu, Itto, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's Itto doing?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: He must be exhausted, because he still hasn't woken up yet. But he's not in any serious danger. So don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: What about you guys? You found something, didn't you? It's written on your faces... but whatever it is, it's bad news, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We found the Fantastic Compass. The previous owner left a message inside, and from the looks of it... there really is no way out of this space after all.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It seems like the previous owner was stuck here forever, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...Shoot.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: This isn't over yet. Listen to me, just now I tried channeling my power into the Fantastic Compass, and it responded.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: But all that did was activate the records from when the seal was created.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Right, but the issue wasn't with the compass. It was with the method.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Remember what the book says? "When mortal and adepti powers are combined, one can move the heavens and shake the earth."

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Only when a mortal and an adeptus combine their powers can the Fantastic Compass be fully activated.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I'm a mix of human and adeptus, so the fact that the Fantastic Compass responded to me shows that the system is still functional. Lucky for us, we also happen to have a full adeptus and a human with training in the magic arts.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: ...Interesting. So that's what was going through your head.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Xiao and Yelan need to cooperate?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: So an adeptus and a human need to channel their power at the same time?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Yes. If my guess is correct, then when both of you put your full power into the Fantastic Compass, we should be able to completely reactivate it... maybe even reverse it.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Last time, it was used to seal the intersection between this place and The Chasm. If we can reverse it...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Then we're home free.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Awesome! So there's still hope?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You bet.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Your idea seems reasonable.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Okay, well let's all take a quick break. We'll give this thing a try once we're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After everyone has had a rest...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh boy, {NICKNAME}, Paimon's so nervous...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't be afraid. This is going to work.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Yelan, Xiao, how are we looking?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'm all set.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Oh, but Yanfei, there's one thing you might need to mentally prepare yourself for.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'm afraid you probably won't be able to take the Fantastic Compass out of here. From what I can tell, everything within this domain is the result of disordered spacetime and memories.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We all came here for different purposes, and everything that's happened here has been in response to our own imaginations and conjecture. Terrifying, but also a miracle.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This "space"... well, it's more than just a space. Whether there's some kind of higher power at work here, I don't know, but... the whole time, it's been reading our minds and responding to us in the form of illusions.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Also, according to the history of The Chasm, this place must've existed for a very long time... What could've created it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I remember a giant snake just outside this space...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Oh, that. Yeah, I was there, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait a second... it was you that shot that arrow!?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Who else did you think it was...?

choices.text: When the crystal attacked the giant snake...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: That snake is probably a remnant of Khaenri'ahn civilization... And crystals are highly effective against it... Maybe there was some sort of opposing reaction between those two forces?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: If so... I'm extremely sorry, everyone. It looks like I might be the one responsible for all of this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no, you're just trying to help us and solve the problem! You're definitely not to blame for what happened.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: ...If you say so.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You could almost liken this bizarre space to a living being that throws all kinds of hallucinations at us to deceive us. Everyone we've seen here, and all the paths we've walked... it all ceased to exist 500 years ago.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Additionally, most of the things here are static. So if we really do manage to escape, then once time starts moving normally again... the Fantastic Compass will likely disappear.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: That's actually what I think, too. That's precisely why it's such a miracle that we even found the Fantastic Compass to begin with.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: This whole thing feels like we're breaking free from our shackles using a spear that by rights should not exist.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: This is a long shot, but it may be our last chance... so, whose wish was it that summoned this device?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Perhaps it was all of us.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Perhaps it was. But maybe there's another reason: your incredibly strong commitment to your search.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: It's a shame that we couldn't find your family... But if they were here, I'm sure they'd want nothing more than to see you being rescued from this place.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Yeah.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I gotta say, it does intrigue me, the way we all ended up here together.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: If this is fate, then let's grab it in our hands and turn it around.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Leave the boss to Ushi and me. We're ready.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Traveler, take care of Paimon. Yanfei, you might need to come closer to me when the time comes.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Sure.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright.

choices.text: Does that have anything to do with why the ground split open?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Finally out of the danger zone, everyone rests and starts chatting...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: That was close! I thought you were gonna get left behind... I'm so glad you're okay, that was terrifying...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I know what you were thinking, but...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Never mind. I know I can't talk you out of a mindset that's been built up over a lifetime.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I don't think we were ever going to reach an agreement over the final strategy. But in the end, it was thanks to you that we managed to escape. So thank you for saving us all.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: No. I could not have done this on my strength alone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So thanks to you, too, Yelan.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Don't mention it.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Looks like everyone got out unscathed, but you all look pretty exhausted. Rest up, there's no hurry to move on from here.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: As for me, I'm gonna check the area for any unusual activity.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's gone... Paimon didn't even get to say thank-you...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Maybe Yelan really doesn't believe she made a contribution. It seems like she's convinced Xiao saved us all... including her, and she doesn't know what to say to that.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And since it's not easy to persuade Xiao of anything. Maybe Yelan's just given up trying to talk to him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xiao, she's criticizing you.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Am not!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You speak only the truth. I have no quarrel with that.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I will keep your words in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like you got through to him.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Really? Well, that's great. I count that as quite an achievement.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It was a perilous situation we were faced with underground, and it took every single one of us for any of us to make it out alive. I feel lucky that we didn't lose anyone along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, so Bull-Chucker still hasn't woken up yet... surely he's not gonna stay asleep forever? Is he?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I doubt it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go check on him!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: *yawn*! Ah, I slept like a rock, good times... Huh? What're you doing? What's going on? Why you looking at me like that?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Are you in any pain?

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo, moo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, the head? What about it? Is there any brain damage from the impact?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You need to tell us if you're not feeling well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You weren't that bright to begin with, so if we add brain damage to the equation... oh brother...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: The heck are you guys talking about? I'm fine! I had an epic power nap, and now I feel like a million Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I feel like I'm forgetting something, though... Oh, yeah! Wait... Weren't we underground? How did we get back up here?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It's a long story. We'll fill you in later.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Itto, we're indebted to you, Shinobu, and Ushi. We couldn't have escaped this predicament without your help.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I'm the reason you all got caught up in this. Please accept my apologies and let me find some way to compensate you for the trouble!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ah, crazy talk. You helped us first, of course we were gonna return the favor.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, if it weren't for you, we'd still be in a Liyue jail cell right now!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: That's not quite correct. You'd be in jail, not me.

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hahaha, good point. Well, okay then, how about this: To celebrate our newfound friendships, how about you let me take you to Liyue Harbor for some sightseeing and a proper meal?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I like the sound of that! Now that you mention it, whew... I am famished... I can barely walk here...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I'm hungry too, Senpai. Why don't we head straight over?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon too, Paimon wants to come too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, we have other things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Ugh, fine...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #Alright, {NICKNAME}, well I promise I'll take good care of your friends from Inazuma. Take it easy, okay? What we just went through was a lot.

choices.text: Yeah. This has been tough on everyone.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oh wait, Yelan left already... I was gonna treat her to some tea, but I'll take this to mean we're square, hehehe.

response.speaker: Ushi
response.text: Moo! Moo, moo, moo!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hmm? Oh yeah? Is that right, whoa... Okay, I'll let them know.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Flying Lavender Melon, Ushi has a couple of words he'd like you to pass on for him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Oh, I wanna hear this.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Me too. Count me in!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Itto translates what Ushi said for everyone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good idea. Let's do that!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Okay.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon never would have guessed that Ushi was so gentle and thoughtful... Never judge a bull by its cover, huh.

response.speaker: Ushi
response.text: Moo.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Sometimes the profoundest truths can also be the simplest. I think Ushi's words may well come in handy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You betcha, just leave it to us.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Alright, Itto, Shinobu, Ushi, let's go.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Aw yeah! Grub time!

response.speaker: Ushi
response.text: Moo!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: See you next time.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Xiao.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Finished taking care of business?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, there wasn't any "business"... we were just saying goodbye to our friends.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Huh, you're still here.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I saw the two Inazumans leave with Yanfei, heading towards Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Aren't you going with them?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We still had some stuff we wanted to say to Xiao.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Hmm, I figured as much.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I've checked the area, nothing strikes me as out of the ordinary. Looks like this chapter has come to a close.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Now I just need to take care of the confidentiality issues. Hehe... Let's hope our friends from overseas can keep their mouths shut, for their own sakes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhhh, we got it, we got it! We'll make sure they don't say anything, please don't hurt them!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Oh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You've got a mean streak, Yelan.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You've figured me out, huh? Hahaha. Alright, I'll quit pulling your leg.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Everyone really rose to the occasion this time. I won't ever forget what we went through.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Where could that strange space have come from... and how has it existed down there undetected for so many years...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I have to investigate this further. I have a feeling that whatever lies behind all this runs deep... maybe so deep that no one can be allowed to know.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Also, I think someone helped us out at the last minute... They did a good deed, of course, but somehow I couldn't tell anything about them. It must've been someone of great importance.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Anyway, these questions will have to wait for another time. I have some follow-up work to do and reports to make, so it's back to Liyue Harbor for me. See you when I see you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bye, Yelan!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Alright.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: You knew I was waiting for you?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yes, it was obvious.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Really...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: There's somewhere I want to go. If you have the time, you can join me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Where is it?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: A place that has to do with the yakshas.

talks.objective: Go to the place Xiao mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The temple up ahead was built to remember Pervases.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Maybe I came here because I had a realization.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean back when we were underground?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did you realize?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: It's hard to put into words... Seeing Bosacius gave me the false impression that I'd traveled back into the past.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...You could dress up the yaksha's life and call us valiant warriors, veterans of war, but... the truth is, we are slaughterers, and nothing more.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: For Bosacius, perhaps dying in the heat of a great battle was no tragedy.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: And perhaps the same is true for me. After living for so long... to die in the act of saving others would not have been a terrible thing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think you know that that isn't true.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Mm. So maybe... these thoughts are my own form of insanity.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, don't say that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Xiao, we've got something to tell you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah! Ushi wanted us to tell you. It's very important.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ushi said he has the power to exorcise demons, so people use him to fend them off. But after he met Itto, he's never left his side.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He also said that he doesn't have any grand philosophies, he just thinks we should spend our lives around the people who make us happiest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe there aren't so many rules about how we should or shouldn't live our lives in this world after all. So... he hopes you can come to understand that even though the power of a yaksha may be harmful to other people, it doesn't mean you shouldn't hang out with them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There will always be someone willing to be by your side.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, like people with Visions — they have more resistance against your power, right? And, and... Well, anyway, there's loads of people out there who really care about you!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Hah. Suddenly, you sound a lot like Bosacius and the others.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: They used to talk about how they hoped to live a mortal's life once the world was at peace. I think... I was the only one who didn't think that way.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The Bosacius recorded in the Fantastic Compass had lost his sanity. He addressed the people around him as "Alatus," "Menogias," and others. These are the names of the Five Yakshas.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I am Alatus, and Menogias is General Kapisas.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The others are Bonanus, or "General Chizapus," and Indarias, or "General Musatas." I heard that people call the five of us "Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti"... Hah.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Bosacius and Yelan's ancestor stayed underground to the end. So that space must have read their minds in their last moments as they approached death.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Yelan was right in everything she said. Both of our proposals had their drawbacks, and both were sensible suggestions. But the power of that space was far beyond all of us.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I couldn't have done all I did without everyone's help. Even in the final moments, it took every bit of my power to break free from that place...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well Paimon still thinks you were amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Yanfei and Yelan are correct. I always prepare for the worst-case scenario. This mindset is deeply rooted in me... Even so, it was the most optimistic solution I could think of.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: If Rex Lapis hadn't saved me in that moment, I don't think I would've been able to escape.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So that was Zhongli's power back there...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: In the end, I still had to burden another.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But that's how it should be, right? You've known Zhongli... uh, Rex Lapis for such a long time, and you've helped him before. So he helped you back, what's the big deal?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Perhaps.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: In the moment that we escaped from that space, I could sense what was left of Bosacius's memory. If I had to say what I gained from this trip, I think that would be it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think I felt it too.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...It's good that one more person will remember him.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I've said so much today. But I don't need to hold back as much when I talk to you.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Have you ever had a moment where you felt like you were aware of your destiny? The potential of life, the approach of death... whatever it might have been.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: By now, I have accepted that destiny is the one disaster that the yaksha knows most keenly of all. We are destined to misery... and yet we have no fear.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Xiao...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you sure it's okay for you to tell me all this?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: It matters not. Rex Lapis had said that you are a witness. It is right that the events of the world are relayed to you.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Bonanus, Menogias, and Indarias all perished, and only Bosacius's fate was unknown. This has always stung my heart like a thorn. That is why I went to The Chasm, despite being fully aware of the danger.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Now that I know what happened in The Chasm back then, I can finally put this matter to rest.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Before we left that place, I picked up a stone. I thought if I could take it out with me, I would place it in the temple to Pervases in memory of Bosacius.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Unfortunately, the stone did not survive.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Pervases died in the Archon War thousands of years ago. He was younger than us, and Bosacius was very sad when he passed.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Too many yakshas have become casualties of battle. We are like a flock of birds scattered to the four corners of the world. And in the end, as Bonanus said... it's rare for a yaksha to find repose for their soul.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Bosacius, Boyang, and all those soldiers...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No, Xiao... They are all heroes.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Heroes...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...I like that word.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Maybe the world will never be free of disaster. But there is good in the world, too. Even the darkest hearts have room for those they cherish.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I accept your advice. From this day on, heroes will always look out for each other.

choices.text: Supporting each other is how people survive.
